# newreleases_providers (Data Source)

Lists upstream providers supported by newreleases.io, the valid values of `provider_name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every provider supported by newreleases.io.
data "newreleases_providers" "all" {}

# Only providers with at least one tracked project.
data "newreleases_providers" "used" {
  added = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `added` (Boolean) When true, only list providers that have at least one tracked project in the account.

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Provider names.
